summary: Candidate skill 'Package Installation Detection' is semantically distinct from all existing skills. It addresses module origin classification (installed vs. local) via path inspection, which is orthogonal to the existing skills' concerns (Spring MVC configuration, timestamp extension). The peer candidates (conditional instrumentation, eligibility checks, version validation) are related but operate at different decision layers and do not subsume this path-based classification capability. No existing skill covers normalized path comparison against site-packages directories.
